title: Deliver Iron Ore to Cardington Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Cardington Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 20,115).

A likely supplier is **Cardington Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 58,107); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **6,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
